speaker: Damián
cn: （惊叹）我以为我有戒指就已经够厉害了，没想到跟真豪门还是比不了啊！爸厉害！
en: (In awe) I thought this ring already gave me a huge advantage, but damn... you really can’t compete with the truly rich and powerful. Way to go, Dad!

speaker: 管家
en: (With respect) You must be Mr. Damián. Please follow me.

speaker: Fernando
cn: Beatriz，这是我儿子，Damián。（跟Damián介绍）Damián，这是我的未婚妻Beatriz，还有她的小女儿，Samanta。
en: Beatriz, this is my son, Damián.

speaker: Fernando
cn: 她们一家是贵族后裔，听说祖上是公爵，你注意点自己的言行举止。
en: They come from an aristocratic family. I heard one of their ancestors was a duke, so mind your manners around them.

speaker: Damián（VO）
cn: 怎么感觉她长得那么像Isadora呢？
en: How come she looks so much like Isadora?

speaker: Samanta
cn: （活动筋骨）妈，这小子看来是个好色的！再多看一眼，我就把他眼睛抠出来！
en: (stretching her muscles) Mom, looks like this guy’s a real creep! If he stares at you one more second, I’ll gouge his eyes out!

speaker: Damián
cn: 你好，我叫Damián，二十五岁，已婚。你就别惦记我了。
en: Hi, I'm Damián, 25 years old, married. Not available.

speaker: Fernando
cn: （不可置信）结婚了？跟Eloísa？那女人都逃婚了，你怎么还跟她结婚？
en: (In disbelief) You're married? To Eloísa? She left you at the altar! Why would you still marry her?

speaker: Samanta
cn: （担忧）妈，这人靠谱吗？不会是奔着咱们家的钱来的吧？（攥拳）而且他儿子看着也很欠揍。
en: (worried) Mom, is this guy trustworthy? He might be after our family's money... (Clenches his fists) Also, his son looks a bit pathetic.

speaker: Beatriz
cn: （笑）不会，Fernando说了，可以做财产公证的。
en: (laughs) No. Fernando said we can sign a prenup.

speaker: Beatriz
en: (Happy) Fernando, my eldest daughter has returned!

speaker: Damián
cn: 爸，你放心，我没跟Eloísa结婚。我老婆叫Isadora！
en: Dad, don't worry—I haven't married Eloísa. My wife's is Isadora.
